Why REVISE rather than APPROVE or REJECT. APPROVE requires findings=[] and could in any case only concern this bounded diagnostic, not whole-plan acceptance. The current finding status index records eleven open blocker findings with null resolution, closable only by a subsequent independent approving review against delivered originals; the author's own SPEC-17 states reviews 1-7 and 9-12 remain open and that this supplementary proposal closes none. The preserved blockers are genuine and must be surfaced in the findings array: U1 input/coverage-root provenance; U2 full/all-arm/production native integration (the collected base smoke is real only for two base arms on fold 0, and the v17 synthetic receipt exercises only AST-extracted pure functions, real_notebook_execution=false); U3 coverage-arm source validation (zscore/histeq and derived_ctp_support correctly held, no authenticated cohort/source/grid/padding originals); STAGE1 full-projection-exceeds-authorized-caps (measured extrapolation ~$2,964-$3,575 versus the $1,200 gate and $1,275 total); STAGE1 partial-arm/single-arm extrapolation with no established steady-state plateau; and F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING. The budget and self-review findings touch spending caps and approved scope and therefore stop for the operator; none of the blockers is closable in this reviewer workspace. REJECT is not warranted because the bounded diagnostic is honestly authored, format-accepted, preserves all prior findings and all original fits/rows, asserts no efficacy or closure, and the defects are addressable through delivery of authenticated provenance, all-arm smoke timings, a re-scoped or re-authorized budget, opposing-family review of the exact bytes, and a new reviewed plan version. No verdict here authorizes GPU, coverage release, the diagnostic dispatch or full training; provider admission and the separate execution-validation and spending gates remain required transitions. The verdict is carried solely by the findings array, not by any prose marker.
